depends_on: completeness of the maximal prime gap list below 2^64 (OEIS A002386/A005250)
notes: Lean: a composite term n has isqrt(n) <= n - p + 1 for every prime p < n (A067126_gap), and if no prime lies in [q^2-q+2, q^2-1] for a prime q then q^2 is a term (A067126_square_term), so the conjecture implies the lower half of Oppermann's conjecture at prime arguments and follows from gaps < isqrt(p+1) for p >= 523. Record gaps below 2^64 satisfy that bound from p = 523 on; sieve to 2e6: only 4, 9. So no other composite term below 2^64 (entry: 1.5e18). Outside Lean: the sieve, the record-gap check and the cited completeness of the maximal-gap list below 2^64.

sources: OEIS A067126 comment (Greathouse 2010: gap > sqrt(p) needed, checked to 1.5e18)
prior_art.note: Gap criterion is in the entry; Lean proof, the Oppermann implication and the 2^64 range are ours.
